zh-TW.name: 宇智波斑
zh-TW.description: 須佐投射現身六秒，骨臂接觸成長為甲胄主刀連斬、另一刀護勢；數量增加實際刀線但維持六秒，不佔本體出手。三階後體術末擊與火牆真命中蓄滿三格，顯現六秒完成體巨刀與前推劍壓。本作勢能改編，不給無敵。 自動施放，不占主動槽。

en.name: Madara Uchiha
en.description: An independent six-second guardian grows from skeletal limbs to armored blades. Quantity adds real blade sweeps without locking the body. Rank 3 unlocks a six-second Perfect Susanoo at three momentum, with gigantic blades and advancing sword pressure. Momentum and timing are game adaptations; no invulnerability. Automatically cast; no active slot required.
